name: RuleEngine::arbitrate

test_list.description: S1 timeout retains every disputed security finding.
Only calibrated high-confidence rejection of finding support removes disputed findings using the canonical question.
Unavailable engine results and uncalibrated schemas retain findings.
Undisputed findings are never removed by S1.
Unrelated schema identities and missing masked evidence preserve findings.
Host-pinned fixture/checkpoint mismatches and foreign CID/span evidence preserve findings.
Only masked evidence reaches the decision engine and Debug output redacts excerpt/context text.
An oversized finding slice is rejected before cloning, evidence scans, or model work.
A canonical schema's shorter fail-policy deadline bounds the decision call.

inputs.name: findings_evidence_schema_trust_timeout
inputs.description: Findings, CID/span-bound caller-masked evidence, canonical S1 schema, host-pinned calibration digests and bounded timeout.

output_description: Findings preserved unless calibrated S1 explicitly clears a disputed finding above threshold.
